exit_criterion: A multi-class spectral dataset imported from one of the new formats is cleaned (outliers flagged and excluded, the exclusion recorded in lineage), variables are selected, and PLS-DA, SIMCA, LDA and kNN are compared under the same stratified cross-validation, each matching its reference within stated tolerance. Separately, PCR and variable-selected PLS on Tecator match their references. Demonstrated by tests/exit_run_phase5.py over HTTP and recorded in docs/phase-5/exit-run.md.
decisions: 2026-10-02. Classifiers: PLS-DA becomes multi-class (on a PLS2 kernel), plus SIMCA, LDA and kNN. SVM is deferred: it needs a hand-written QP solver.
2026-10-02. Outlier detection flags; the user excludes. An exclusion is a derived DatasetVersion (excluded_samples, derived_from), never a pipeline step that drops rows.
2026-10-02. Variable selection: VIP or coefficient threshold, iPLS and CARS, each applied as an explicit select_variables step. Genetic algorithms are deferred.
2026-10-02. File formats: MATLAB .mat, Thermo Galactic SPC, Thermo OMNIC SPA, ASD. Each with a real, licensed fixture.
2026-10-02. Smoothing: moving average, median, Gaussian, Whittaker.

2026-10-02. Unchanged: scikit-learn and chemotools stay development dependencies. Every kernel is hand-written; parity is against a reference library, mdatools, or recorded not_compared with a reason.
2026-10-02. One release, v1.1.0, at the end of the phase. Phase 4's timed exit run stays closed as recorded in docs/phase-4/.
